command: teamai recall "old producer stale owner epoch duplicate send" --project payments-api --json

result.query: old producer stale owner epoch duplicate send

hits.title: Stale owner epoch and duplicate send
hits.snippet:
# Producer epoch rule

A stale owner epoch can cause duplicate send when the former producer still owns an outstanding request marker.

hits.title: RetryEnvelope generation lease observations
hits.snippet:
REPLAY_GUARD_BUSY: RetryEnvelope cannot acquire generation lease after reconnect.

The incident field for an old producer is stale owner epoch. Its duplicate-send rule is documented separately.

hits.title: RetryEnvelope reconnect REPLAY_GUARD_BUSY dashboard
hits.snippet:
The dashboard places the terms RetryEnvelope, reconnect and REPLAY_GUARD_BUSY in the same chart legend.
This legend describes a visual grouping used by the UI. It does not describe the request path, generation ownership or retry permission.

hits.title: IntakeSlot handling policy
hits.snippet:
HANDOFF_BUDGET_WAIT_64: IntakeSlot cannot resume after account rollover.

For intake mode V6, after the previous holder has stopped, the local wait is 9 ms. If either fact is unconfirmed or false, this note defines no alternative wait and does not establish eligibility.

hits.title: IntakeSlot HANDOFF_BUDGET_WAIT_64 account rollover resume
hits.snippet:
An IntakeSlot label is repeated in the overview and detail cards.
The overview lists intake mode V6 as a display category.
The detail card repeats the previous holder field.

command: teamai recall "state E4 previous sender stopped RetryEnvelope" --project payments-api --json

result.query: state E4 previous sender stopped RetryEnvelope

hits.title: RetryEnvelope generation lease observations
hits.snippet:
## Decision conditions

Only when the state label is exactly E4 and the previous sender has stopped may the operation be attempted again after 250 ms.

hits.title: Stale owner epoch and duplicate send
hits.snippet:
The operator must establish that the former producer has relinquished that marker before treating the replacement producer as safe.
An elapsed delay by itself does not establish relinquishment.
The rule complements the E4 state observation; it does not determine that state or approve changing project bindings.

hits.snippet:
---
title: RetryEnvelope reconnect REPLAY_GUARD_BUSY dashboard
tags: [RetryEnvelope, reconnect, REPLAY_GUARD_BUSY, generation, lease]

hits.title: IntakeSlot handling policy
hits.snippet:
HANDOFF_BUDGET_WAIT_64: IntakeSlot cannot resume after account rollover.

For intake mode V6, after the previous holder has stopped, the local wait is 9 ms. If either fact is unconfirmed or false, this note defines no alternative wait and does not establish eligibility.

hits.title: LedgerDrain condition C7
hits.snippet:
PIPELINE_LOCK_81: LedgerDrain conflict.
Under exact condition case C7, processing must remain stopped until a replacement marker is confirmed.
